audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle in both layers. The packet reads Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, and the prose sides with the packet: whys[0] 'you own nothing here', whys[1] 'he chunks you freely, so play back', whys[2] 'a knife-edge... even', whys[4] and mid both call level 6 the flip.
audit.why: Kayle is melee until Divine Ascent's ranged tier; Lucian is a 500-range Q with a double-shot passive. Levels 1-2 are not even and level 6 is not a coin-flip — the page currently claims the reverse of both.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 set to Lucian, row 2 to Skill, row 4 to Kayle — four matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's zero-sequencing defect is real. 'Engage when Relentless Pursuit is down' appears a dozen times with no number, and the one number that matters is not a fixed timer at all.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 but Lightslinger attacks reduce it, so a player counting sixteen seconds walks into a dash that is already back. That is the single most punishable-looking cooldown on the page and it is the one that lies.
audit.corrected: 16s written in alongside the warning that his attacks shorten it (dosFull[0].d, early); Piercing Light's 9s and Divine Judgment's 160s added where they gate a decision.
sources: enemyKit E cd 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 and text 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown'

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightslinger is named throughout but never explained as the tell it is: every ability Lucian casts loads a double-shot on his next attack. Separately, the brief's needs-antiheal rule fires on Lightslinger and I did NOT act on it.
audit.why: The readable moment in a Lucian trade is the ability cast, because the double-shot follows it — a player watching for the autos is already a beat late. On the anti-heal flag: Riot's Lightslinger text says his damage is empowered 'when Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally'. That is Lucian receiving healing, not producing it. Grievous Wounds bought on the strength of that flag is a wasted item slot, so per the brief's rule I trusted the description over the derived flag.
audit.corrected: The double-shot-follows-the-cast tell written into early. No anti-heal advice added.

audit.why: 53.54% over 988 games, consistent with FAV via scaling.
Lightslinger is the real passive name. False positive.

edits.before: At level 2 he has Q poke plus an E dash while you have only Q and one W heal — he chunks you freely, so play back.
edits.after: He has Piercing Light (9s) plus a 16s E dash while you hold one Q and one W heal — he chunks you freely, so play back.

edits.before: At 6 Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with AoE waves and R grants full invulnerability — you finally match his range and blank his all-in.
edits.after: At 6 Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged and Divine Judgment (160s) blanks The Culling — you finally match his range and take the lane.

edits.before: Lucian is exactly the ranged lane bully that punishes Kayle's worst stretch. Levels 1-3 you have short melee range, only Q (Radiant Blast) for poke, and a single point of W to heal, while his Lightslinger double-tap and Q line chunk you from a range you cannot answer. Do not trade — last-hit from max distance, eat the poke, and W to top up. Respect his E dash plus partner ganks; one all-in before you have R simply kills you.
edits.after: Lucian is exactly the ranged lane bully that punishes Kayle's worst stretch. Levels 1-3 you have short melee range, only Q (Radiant Blast) for poke, and one point of W to heal, while his Q line chunks you from range you cannot answer. Every ability he casts loads a Lightslinger double-shot, so the cast is your cue to step back, not the autos that follow. Last-hit from max distance and W to top up. Relentless Pursuit reads as 16s, but his attacks cut it — never count on the full timer.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His dash — 16s, but every Lightslinger attack cuts it; never assume a full timer.

notes: Rejected one of the brief's missing-interaction rules: needs-antiheal on Lightslinger. Riot's text has Lucian being healed or shielded BY AN ALLY as the trigger for bonus damage — he does no healing himself. The derived flag misfired on tooltip parsing, exactly the case the instructions say to trust the description over. No Grievous Wounds advice added. Left row 3 (Levels 4-5) at Skill rather than following the packet to Kayle: whys[3] says you are 'one level from flipping it', which is not a claim that you have flipped it. Mirror (lucian__kayle) not yet audited.
